note: PREREQUISITE: an ADULT save (the chain's graduation autosave). Retail offers the two farm cards at Gameflow stage 300 -> 400: stage 300 waits on MsgOnQuestCompleted('QS_GuardianSisterInfo') -- after the wasp boss -- then AddQuestCard('OBJECT_QUEST_CARD_PROTECT_FARM', 'Q_OrchardFarmRaidGood') and the evil twin, and stage 400 polls IsQuestActive on either. Accepting a card IS ActivateQuest, so this checklist starts the quest the same way the board would

on the v6 bundle the Gameflow host is LUAGameflow/LUAGameflow and on v7 it is Gameflow/Gameflow -- send the line to whichever `list` reports. Q_OrchardFarmRaid itself is the shared script; Good/Evil are the two wrappers

map slot 9 = OrchardFarm (forge world: origin 3200,3168, 96x128, region OrchardFarm; slot 10 is OrchardFarmEast). z from `forge heights OrchardFarm 48,64` = 42.49. Arm the transition ONCE per crossing (GOTCHAS)
Q_OrchardFarmRaid.Main binds nine entities (TeamSpawn x2, Artefact, OrchardFarmWhisper, CrateTeamMember x2, FarmRearEntrance and the two intro markers) before it starts its threads
DoCutsceneIfRequired picks the Whisper intro by where the hero came from (GWL / GWLL / LOP); the crate counter is AddQuestInfoCounter('HUD_QUEST_ICON_SMALL_CRATE', 3, 1.0)

the raid is a crate-carrying game between GuardTeam and BanditTeam; HeroTeam 0 = guard (Good), 1 = bandit (Evil). This step only proves the rules thread is running and answering -- the crate carrying itself is the next increment

the rules thread ends on MissionSucceeded (outro macro + SetQuestAsCompleted on the active quest and its Good/Evil twin) or MissionFailed 1/2/3 (FailReasons_N: TEXT_QST_051_FAILED_CRATES_STOLEN / _HERO_KILLED / _TEAM_KILLED). Staged here the way the melee checklist stages DummyHits
